_provenance.what: dev topology as shipped: envs/dev.tfvars, single_nat_gateway = true. CONFORMING: must pass FIN-002 under the dev ceiling.
_provenance.kind: POINT-IN-TIME ESTIMATE. Real output of the tool named below, run once, locally, against a copy of the vendored root module. Prices are what the Infracost Cloud Pricing API returned at timeGenerated; they are not a measurement of anything running, and nothing in this repo re-prices them. CI evaluates this file as committed bytes only - no credential, no network, no Infracost call.
_provenance.tool: Infracost v0.10.45 (directory / HCL mode - no terraform init, plan or apply; no AWS credentials)
_provenance.command: infracost breakdown --path terraform --terraform-var-file envs/dev.tfvars --project-name dev --format json --out-file <target>
_provenance.run_from: a temporary copy of gates/fixtures/historical/ holding terraform/ and modules/ side by side, so terraform/iam.tf's ../modules/iam/* references resolve; the copy was discarded after the run and the evidence tree was never the working directory
_provenance.this_key: _provenance is the ONE key added to the tool's output, in the same position the retired _synthetic marker occupied. Remove it and the remainder is the breakdown exactly as infracost wrote it.
